title: hotfix: SLO enforcer backoff/regional failover stability under burst
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff to prevent regional failover thrashing under bursty load. Includes debounce, safer region selection, additional observability and tests.
description: Background: after a production incident on 2026-02-26 we observed SLO-enforcer backoff thrashing under bursty traffic which caused repeated regional failovers and client errors. This PR applies a safety-focused hotfix: (1) introduce a debounce window and jittered exponential backoff for the enforcer to avoid immediate failovers on transient spikes, (2) remove a race in region selection that could select a downed region during parallel evaluation, (3) tighten rate-limit to avoid cascading shedding when regional capacity reports lag, (4) add targeted metrics and traces for enforcer decisions and failover causes, (5) add an integration test that reproduces the burst pattern and verify stability, and (6) provide a quick runbook and k8s rollout script for emergency rollback. Changes are intentionally conservative and behind feature flag slo.enforcer.hotfix_77250 for quick rollback. Testing: unit tests, integration test harness (regional-failover-sim) and canary rollout on staging. Rollback plan: disable slo.enforcer.hotfix_77250 flag and scale down new enforcer pods; runbook updated in docs/runbooks/slo-enforcer-failover.md. Related: ENG-1984, SRE-224.

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Please explain why we chose a 3s debounce and 30s max backoff. Concern: long backoff could delay recovery for genuine multi-region outages.

Aisha Patel: Chosen values are conservative based on production spike telemetry; added jitter and capped growth to 30s to balance recovery vs thrash. Updated comment in backoff_policy.go to document rationale.
Diego Martinez: Found potential nil-deref in regional_failover.go when regionStatus is empty. Requesting nil-check and unit test coverage.
Aisha Patel: Added nil-check and unit test that triggers empty region status; test passes locally and in CI.
